- .github/workflows/promote-main-to-stable.yml:160-170 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m2_5, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The post-push `git ls-remote` verification can turn a transient network/auth failure into a misleading ref-mismatch error with an empty `REMOTE_AFTER`.
  WHY: A failed `git ls-remote` leaves the comparison against `${TARGET}` true and exits 1 even though the push itself already succeeded.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:~189-195 | severity=low | confidence=4

  PROBLEM: The post-push verification fetch has no bounded retry, so a transient fetch failure after a successful push can fail the workflow unnecessarily.
  WHY: The propagation already landed; this is a false-negative verification failure rather than a merge failure.
- .github/workflows/forward-merge-stable-to-main.yml:194-217 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, z-ai_glm-5]
  PROBLEM: The verification failure path’s fallback `git ls-remote` calls are not fault-tolerant, so they can emit empty or misleading SHA diagnostics when the network blips.
